messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hi Aliya:
I just wanted to let you know I'll have no problem delivering this by the middle of the afternoon on Friday (12/8).

Have a great day.
\-Gordon

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Thanks Gordon! I'll actually be OOO on Friday and Monday. Do you think you can share your work in a Google Doc with noah@fireandspark.com and <http://joshua@fireandspark.com?|joshua@fireandspark.com?> They can review your work while I'm out and I can send the payment and feedback when I'm back in the office on Tuesday.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: No problem. Thanks for the direction. I’ll include those individuals in the share setting. Have a good weekend!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hi Aliya:
Since it's been a few days since we talked, I just wanted to confirm that you received my deliverable.
Thanks, and have a great day!
\-Gordon

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Hi Gordon!

Thanks for following up. I just finished going through your article and you did a great job. Your writing is strong, but the blog can be made even better with a bit more storytelling – think engaging intros to break up long informational lists. My team and I added our feedback to the article for you to review and make relevant edits.

After you've had a chance to review and edit, we'll be all set to pass your test article along to our client. Your work is much appreciated on this, and am looking forward to your revised version.

Article with Fire&Spark feedback: <https://docs.google.com/document/d/1qoeAK7iJ0lgNA9-204BWbD4NZef54o6XKB4nTS11WNA/edit#heading=h.urzahnmktvtk>

Let me know if you have any questions!

Thanks,
Aliya

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hi Aliya:
Good to hear back from you, I'll review the edits you have provided. When do you need an updated draft from me completed?

\-Gordon

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: If we could have them by tomorrow morning that would be great, but if that is too quick of a turnaround, by the end of the week is fine as well.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
ok. let me see what I can pull together.
I guess I only have one general question on the comments: I noticed there's a general ask for more content/words, which is fine, I can do. Originally, I was trying to keep the content very terse so I could fit underneath the 1000 words requirement for the blog. If you're okay with going over a little bit, I can definitely add in more intros where noted. I just wanted to make sure that wasn't a hard word limit requirement.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: It is not a hard word limit but I appreciate your attention to detail here!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hi Aliya:
I think I've addressed your comments in the google doc you've provided. I left the one comment you had open so you can see my resolution.
<https://docs.google.com/document/d/1qoeAK7iJ0lgNA9-204BWbD4NZef54o6XKB4nTS11WNA/edit?usp=sharing>

I had fun working on this project and hope we can work together again soon!
\-Gordon

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
The blog looks great! The edits were exactly what we were looking for. Our next step from here is to share your test article with our client. Once they review and approve your work, I'll follow up with you to discuss a monthly copywriting cadence, pay, and timeframes.

Talk soon!
Aliya

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Fantastic! I'm glad to hear that.
I look forward to hearing from you again soon; I hope you and the team have a good weekend and a restful holiday season if I don't hear back from you until after that.

\-Gordon

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hi Aliya:
I know we're right up against the end of the year and the holiday season, but I just wanted to follow up with you to see if you had any feedback from your client on the test article I did. I am available to start whenever you are ready!

Have a relaxing end to the year!
\-Gordon G.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Hi Gordon. I hope you had a great holiday weekend and thanks for reaching out! Our client's site just launched so it's been a crazy few weeks. That being said, they have not yet reviewed your work, but I'm hoping to get some feedback from them this week. I will follow up with you as soon as I know more.

Happy New Year,
Aliya

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Hi Gordon,

Great news! Century Spring reviewed your work and wants to set up a time to meet with you. They'd like to learn more about your background and give you some context on their company and brand. Please let me know if you are available for a call this week.

The team also provided some feedback and edit suggestions on your test article that you can view here: <https://docs.google.com/document/d/1jTtblasgpeqKY31Tqyji9rMj48t3BcHGAQXeyBGtyfE/edit?usp=sharing>

Please let me know if you have any questions!

Aside from setting up this meeting, my team would like to assign you your next copywriting task. This time, instead of writing a blog article, you'll update copy for an existing landing page on <http://centuryspring.com|centuryspring.com>. I can send over the brief tomorrow. As far as your rates go, how many hours will you expect a copy editing project to take?

Thanks!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hi Aliya:
I would love to meet with Century Spring. Thanks for passing along the feedback! I'm not sure what time slots you have available, but the best times for me are any day this week before 11am EST, or Tuesday/Wednesday/Friday this week after 1pm EST. Unfortunately, I'm pretty booked up this afternoon (Monday), so that won't work for me.

Let me look at that landing page and get back to you with an hour's estimate here this afternoon.

I guess the only question I am curious about is: if the meeting with Century Spring goes well and they like what I have to offer, how much work do you envision this total project to be? I just ask because the more information I have about a project, the better I am able to plan and prioritize my time.

Thanks!
\-Gordon G.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Great! I'll pass along your available times and follow up with a Google Meets invite. What is the best email to send the invitation to?

The specific landing page you'll be updating is this one: <https://www.centuryspring.com/compression-springs>. As we did in the last brief, we'll provide specific instructions on what we'd like to see in each section.

As of now, we're expecting around 4 assignments per month. We expect blogs to take longer than copy-editing assignments so we may swap out 1 blog for 2 copy-editing tasks as needed.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
I used a dedicated email address for this type of work. You can send to: gordon.grob@rustbeltpublishing.com

Thanks for the update on workflow!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hi Aliya:
I think it's reasonable to quote approximately **5 hours** to rework the copy on the page you've provided. I'm good with keeping the previous hourly rate I quoted to you for the first article ($45/hr) and the same lead time upon receipt of contract and all materials needed to start work (4 days).

I hope those terms are reasonable to you. I am available to start as soon as you need me to begin!

\-Gordon G.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Sounds good to me thank you for the update! I can send over a new milestone tomorrow :)

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I just sent you a meeting invite for tomorrow at 1 pm ET!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: got it. I will be there then (in case you hadn't seen the google confirmation)!
